name: Virginia Steel & Fabrication
old_description: Virginia Steel & Fabrication stands as a cornerstone in the steel fabrication industry, dedicated to delivering exceptional services across the Appalachian region. With over 34 years of expertise, our company prides itself on its specialization in structural steel fabrication, conveyor systems, custom fabrication, and welding solutions. We cater to a diverse range of clients, from contractors to industrial facilities, ensuring precision and quality in every project we undertake. Our commitment to craftsmanship and reliable service has solidified our reputation as a trusted partner for both large and small scale projects.
about:
Virginia Steel & Fabrication operates from Bastian, Virginia, in the heart of the Appalachian region. The company was founded in 1992 on principles of craftsmanship and customer-focused service, and describes itself as an Appalachian-built business with deep roots and long-standing relationships. No founder names are disclosed, and ownership structure is not specified.

The shop provides structural steel fabrication, conveyor system fabrication, custom metal fabrication (including railings, stairs, platforms, and ladders), welding, design and detailing, and project management. It also runs a retail steel service offering steel sales and custom cuts for contractors, businesses, and homeowners. The company references modern equipment and skilled craftsmen but does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Customers include general contractors, mining operations, industrial facilities, and regional partners across the Appalachian area. The firm emphasizes a single point of contact through project management to coordinate schedules, materials, communication, and delivery.

Virginia Steel says its differentiation comes from decades of practical experience, a people-first approach, and a commitment to safety in the shop and on job sites. The mission is to deliver dependable steel fabrication solutions built on experience, craftsmanship, and long-standing relationships.
